summary: This section of the Form 8-K filing by Foot Locker, Inc. includes the preface detailing compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, including company information and regulatory checkboxes. It summarizes the results of the May 18, 2022, shareholder meeting, highlighting the election of Board nominees, approval of executive compensation, and auditor ratification. Additionally, it notes the appointment of Ms. Nicosia as the audit committee financial expert, emphasizing her qualifications and experience. Finally, it outlines the financial statements and exhibits, including the Cover Page Interactive Data File and a signature confirming the report's authenticity.

children.title: preface

It includes essential information such as the date of the report, the company's name, jurisdiction of incorporation, and contact details. The section also provides checkboxes for various regulatory communications and indicates the company's stock trading symbol and exchange. Additionally, it addresses the status of the company as an emerging growth entity and its election regarding financial accounting standards compliance.

children.title: 2022 Shareholder Vote Results at Foot Locker, Inc.
children.summary: This section outlines the results of shareholder votes at Foot Locker, Inc.'s annual meeting on May 18, 2022. It includes the election of ten Board of Directors nominees, approval of named executive officers' compensation, preference for annual advisory votes on NEO compensation, and ratification of KPMG LLP as the auditor for 2022. Specific vote counts and outcomes are provided for each proposal, reflecting shareholder engagement and decisions on governance and executive pay. The section emphasizes the importance of shareholder participation in corporate governance matters.

children.title: Election Results for Board of Directors Nominees
children.summary: This section details the results of the shareholder vote at Foot Locker, Inc.'s annual meeting on May 18, 2022, specifically focusing on Proposal 1, which involved the election of ten nominees to the Board of Directors for a one-year term. It provides the number of votes for, against, and abstentions for each nominee, indicating that all ten were duly elected. The section also mentions the total number of shares outstanding and the quorum present at the meeting, which is essential for validating the voting process.

children.title: Approval of Named Executive Officers' Compensation

A total of 57,172,731 votes were cast in favor, while 13,324,080 votes were against, and 170,172 abstained, leading to the approval of the NEOs' compensation. The section provides specific vote counts and highlights the advisory nature of the proposal, indicating shareholder sentiment towards executive pay.

children.title: Shareholder Vote Frequency for NEO Compensation Approval

Shareholders voted on whether this vote should occur every 1, 2, or 3 years. The results showed a strong preference for an annual vote, with 66,076,265 votes for 1 year, leading to the decision to include an annual advisory vote in proxy materials until the next frequency vote in 2028. This section highlights shareholder engagement in executive compensation oversight.

A total of 75,612,318 votes were cast in favor, 1,854,695 against, and 84,193 abstentions. The section confirms that the appointment was duly ratified based on these results, indicating shareholder support for KPMG LLP's continued role as the company's auditor.

children.title: Appointment of Audit Committee Financial Expert
children.summary: On May 18, 2022, the Board appointed Ms. Nicosia as the audit committee financial expert following Matthew McKenna's retirement. Ms. Nicosia was deemed qualified under the Securities Exchange Act due to her extensive experience in finance and accounting, including her role as president of a multinational corporation. She has a strong background in analyzing financial statements and internal controls, and has served on the Company’s Audit Committee, enhancing her familiarity with audit functions. The Board noted that other directors may also meet the qualifications for this designation.
children.text:

Item 8.01.
Other Events.
 
On May 18, 2022, in light of Matthew
McKenna’s retirement, the Board designated Ms. Nicosia as the “audit committee financial expert.” In
connection with
this designation, the Board determined that Ms. Nicosia qualifies as an “audit committee financial expert,” as defined by
the rules under
the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), because of her relevant experience as
president of an operating unit of a large
multinational corporation. She has supervised the finance and accounting professionals responsible
for, and personally analyzed and evaluated, financial
statements, as well as internal controls over financial reporting. She is also familiar
with audit committee functions through her service on the Company’s
Audit Committee. The Board also believes that there are other
directors who would also qualify for this designation.
